Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a tight set of next steps so we can lock a 60-minute Ops workshop (goal: validate integration pattern, SSO flow, and expected cost profile for the pilot):

- Key outcomes from discovery: you want predictable inference latency for batch jobs, private VPC option for PHI, and an initial pilot with 1–2 models.
- Suggested workshop scope (60 min): 10m intros + 30m environment walkthrough & demo + 15m SSO/security Qs + 5m next steps / mutual action plan.

Proposed 60-minute windows (all PT / please confirm timezone):
1) Tue Sep 14 — 9:00–10:00 PT
2) Tue Sep 14 — 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred for your EMEA-tilted engineers)
3) Wed Sep 15 — 11:00–12:00 PT

We can host on Zoom or Google Meet — if you have an org preference let me know and I’ll send the calendar invite. Please confirm:
- Which slot works (or share alternatives)
- Final attendee list (names + roles + email) so we can include any security/infra contacts up front
- Any prework you want us to circulate (we attached a short agenda and a mutual action plan draft for review)

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_ops-workshop-agenda.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: MH_mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX)]

Marcus (cc) will lead the live environment walkthrough. Happy to make the session shorter if you prefer a compact technical run-through.

Thanks —
